neighbor_control_method: Bracket each group of four candidates by the adjacent V3 controls (initial/after04, after04/after08, after08/after12, after12/after16); report the mean of both control means/medians. If only one control is complete for a budget, use and disclose that one.

allocation_model.stored_payload_formula: 4 * stored_slice_count * N * N bytes (two uint16 operands)
allocation_model.gap_padding_formula: stored_slices * ((N/32)*(N/256)) * (A_gap_bytes+B_gap_bytes), for N panel-aligned as in this screen
allocation_model.residual_formula: one temporary double per packed element, with A then B using the same size; includes gap-expanded slab pitches
allocation_model.cache_semantics: per-caller-thread retained-workspace cap, not a live-allocation limit; actual peak estimate is packed arrays plus one operand's residual buffer; input/output and other runtime storage excluded
allocation_model.metadata_estimate_issue: search metadata currently multiplies by product budget instead of source stored-slice count; corrected source-derived values are used below and discrepancy is flagged per budget
